import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

import type { TypePreparedFiles } from '@arfa-tools/generator';
import * as biome from '@biomejs/wasm-nodejs';

const workspaceDirectory = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const biomeConfigPath = path.resolve(workspaceDirectory, 'biome.json');

biome.main();

const workspace = new biome.Workspace();
const { projectKey } = workspace.openProject({ path: workspaceDirectory, openUninitialized: true });

workspace.updateSettings({
  projectKey,
  workspaceDirectory,
  configuration: JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(biomeConfigPath, 'utf-8')),
});

export function format(files: TypePreparedFiles): TypePreparedFiles {
  return files.map(({ content, filePath, plugin }) => {
    workspace.openFile({
      projectKey,
      path: filePath,
      content: { type: 'fromClient', content, version: 0 },
    });

    let result: biome.FixFileResult;

    try {
      result = workspace.fixFile({
        projectKey,
        path: filePath,
        fixFileMode: 'safeAndUnsafeFixes',
        shouldFormat: true,
        ruleCategories: ['syntax', 'lint', 'action'],
      });
    } finally {
      workspace.closeFile({ projectKey, path: filePath });
    }

    return { content: result.code, filePath, plugin };
  });
}

ts
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

import {
  CheckerBoundaries,
  CheckerCli,
  FileGenerator,
  PluginReexport,
  PluginTranslations,
  PluginValidators,
  type TypeMessage,
} from '@arfa-tools/generator';

import { createMessages } from '../src/shared/i18n/createMessages.ts';
import { format } from './format.ts';

const filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const rootDir = path.resolve(path.dirname(filename), '..');
const sourceDir = path.resolve(rootDir, 'src');
const exclude = /(^_|^index\.ts$|^messages\.ts$|\.css$|\.d\.ts$|\.md$|package\.json$)/;
const headerTemplate = `// biome-ignore-all assist/source/organizeImports: This file is auto-generated\n\n`;

function upperFirst(value: string): string {
  return `${value.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}${value.slice(1)}`;
}

function parseMessages(filePath: string): Array<TypeMessage> {
  const source = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf-8');
  const content = source.replace(/^[\s\S]*?export\s+const\s+messages\s*=\s*/, 'return ');

  if (content === source) throw new Error(`Messages export not found in: ${filePath}`);

  const messages = new Function('createMessages', content)(createMessages);

  return Object.values(messages);
}

export const generator = new FileGenerator({
  rootDir: sourceDir,
  headerTemplate,
  historyPath: path.resolve(rootDir, '.llm/history.jsonl'),
  format,
  plugins: [
    new PluginTranslations([
      {
        entries: ['**/messages.ts'],
        targetFile: path.resolve(sourceDir, 'shared/i18n/usedTranslations.json'),
        languages: ['en'],
        baseLanguage: 'en',
        getKey({ name }) {
          return name;
        },
        parseMessages,
        async translate() {
          return '';
        },
      },
    ]),
    new PluginValidators([
      {
        entries: ['shared/api/*/contracts'],
        exclude,
        targetFolder: path.resolve(sourceDir, 'shared/api/validators'),
        tsconfigPath: path.resolve(rootDir, 'tsconfig.json'),
        requestDeclaration: 'TypeRequest',
        responseDeclaration: 'TypeResponse',
        formatContent({ schema, targetPath }) {
          return `export const ${path.parse(targetPath).name} = ${JSON.stringify(schema, null, 2)} as const;\n`;
        },
      },
    ]),
    new PluginReexport([
      {
        entries: ['pages/*'],
        exclude,
        noPackage: true,
        fileNameTemplate: () => 'index.ts',
        template({ folderName }) {
          const pageName = `${upperFirst(folderName)}Page`;

          return `export { ${pageName} } from './ui/${pageName}';`;
        },
      },
      {
        entries: ['shared/api/*'],
        exclude: /(^validators$|^index\.ts$)/,
        noPackage: true,
        fileNameTemplate: () => 'index.ts',
        template({ files }) {
          return files
            .filter(({ ext }) => ext === '.ts')
            .map(({ name }) => `export type * from './${name}';`)
            .join('\n');
        },
      },
      {
        entries: ['pages/*/api'],
        exclude,
        noPackage: true,
        fileNameTemplate: () => 'index.ts',
        template({ files }) {
          return files.map(({ name }) => `export { ${name} } from './${name}';`).join('\n');
        },
        validateContent({ name, content }) {
          return content.includes(`export async function ${name}(`);
        },
      },
      {
        entries: ['shared/lib/*', 'shared/i18n'],
        exclude,
        noPackage: true,
        fileNameTemplate: () => 'index.ts',
        template({ files }) {
          return files
            .filter(({ ext }) => ['.ts', '.tsx', '.json'].includes(ext))
            .map(({ name, ext, fileName }) =>
              ext === '.json'
                ? `export { default as ${name} } from './${fileName}';`
                : `export * from './${name}';`
            )
            .join('\n');
        },
      },
      {
        entries: ['pages/*/ui/*'],
        exclude,
        onlyPackage: true,
        fileNameTemplate({ folderName }) {
          return `${upperFirst(folderName)}.tsx`;
        },
        template: () => '',
      },
      {
        entries: ['shared/ui/*'],
        exclude,
        fileNameTemplate: () => 'index.ts',
        template({ files }) {
          return files
            .filter(({ ext }) => ['.ts', '.tsx'].includes(ext))
            .map(({ name }) => `export * from './${name}';`)
            .join('\n');
        },
      },
    ]),
  ],
  checkers: [
    new CheckerBoundaries({
      tsconfigPath: path.resolve(rootDir, 'tsconfig.json'),
      extensions: ['.ts', '.tsx'],
      rules: [
        {
          entries: ['app/**'],
          allow: {
            imports: [
              'pages/*/index.ts',
              'shared/api/*/index.ts',
              'shared/i18n/index.ts',
              'shared/lib/*/index.ts',
              'shared/ui/*/index.ts',
            ],
            importsInsideScope: 'all',
            external: true,
          },
        },
        {
          entries: ['pages/**'],
          allow: {
            imports: [
              'shared/api/*/index.ts',
              'shared/i18n/index.ts',
              'shared/lib/*/index.ts',
              'shared/ui/*/index.ts',
            ],
            importsInsideScope: 'sameTopLevel',
            external: true,
          },
        },
        {
          entries: ['shared/**'],
          allow: {
            imports: [],
            importsInsideScope: 'all',
            external: true,
          },
        },
      ],
    }),
    new CheckerCli({
      name: 'biome',
      getCommand({ changedFiles }) {
        if (changedFiles.length === 0) return false;

        return [
          path.resolve(rootDir, 'node_modules/.bin/biome'),
          'check',
          '--no-errors-on-unmatched',
          ...changedFiles.map(({ relativePath }) => relativePath),
        ];
      },
    }),
    new CheckerCli({
      name: 'tsc',
      getCommand: () => [path.resolve(rootDir, 'node_modules/.bin/tsc')],
    }),
  ],
});

import { logsToConsole, type TypeGenerateResult } from '@arfa-tools/generator';
import { build, preview } from 'vite';

import { generator } from './generator.ts';
import { closeReloadConnections, reloadPlugin, sendReloadSignal } from './reloadPlugin.ts';

const isWatch = process.argv.includes('--watch');

async function afterCheckers() {
  await build({
    logLevel: 'warn',
    plugins: isWatch ? [reloadPlugin] : [],
    build: { watch: null, minify: false, cssMinify: false, reportCompressedSize: false },
  });
}

function afterFinish(result: TypeGenerateResult) {
  logsToConsole(result.logs, { verbosity: 'normal' });

  sendReloadSignal();
}

await generator.runFullCycle({ afterCheckers, afterFinish });

if (isWatch) {
  await generator.startWatch({ aggregationTimeout: 50, afterCheckers, afterFinish });

  const server = await preview({
    plugins: [reloadPlugin],
    preview: { host: '0.0.0.0', port: 5174 },
  });

  server.printUrls();

  let isShuttingDown = false;

  async function shutdown(): Promise<void> {
    if (isShuttingDown) return;

    isShuttingDown = true;

    await generator.stopWatch();

    closeReloadConnections();

    server.httpServer.close();
  }

  process.once('SIGINT', () => void shutdown());
  process.once('SIGTERM', () => void shutdown());
}

import { logsToConsole, type TypeGenerateResult } from '@arfa-tools/generator';
import { build, createServer } from 'vite';

import { generator } from './generator.ts';

const isWatch = process.argv.includes('--watch');

function afterFinish(result: TypeGenerateResult) {
  logsToConsole(result.logs, { verbosity: 'normal' });
}

await generator.runFullCycle({ afterFinish });

if (isWatch) {
  await generator.startWatch({ aggregationTimeout: 50, afterFinish });

  const vite = await createServer({ server: { host: '0.0.0.0' } });

  await vite.listen();

  vite.printUrls();

  let isShuttingDown = false;

  async function shutdown(): Promise<void> {
    if (!isShuttingDown) {
      isShuttingDown = true;

      await generator.stopWatch();

      await vite.close();
    }
  }

  process.once('SIGINT', () => void shutdown());
  process.once('SIGTERM', () => void shutdown());
} else {
  await build({ build: { watch: null } });
}

import type { ServerResponse as TypeServerResponse } from 'node:http';

import type { Plugin as TypeVitePlugin } from 'vite';

const clients = new Set<TypeServerResponse>();

export const reloadPlugin: TypeVitePlugin = {
  name: 'pageReload',
  transformIndexHtml() {
    return [
      {
        tag: 'script',
        injectTo: 'body',
        children: `(function refresh() {
  let attempt = 0;
  const maxAttempts = 3;

  window.addEventListener('load', () => {
    const events = new EventSource('/reload');
    events.addEventListener('reload', () => window.location.reload());
    events.onopen = () => { attempt = 0; };
    events.onerror = () => attempt < maxAttempts ? attempt++ : events.close();
  }, { once: true });
})();`,
      },
    ];
  },
  configurePreviewServer(server) {
    server.middlewares.use((req, res, next) => {
      if (req.url !== '/reload') {
        next();
        return;
      }

      res.writeHead(200, {
        'Cache-Control': 'no-cache, no-transform',
        Connection: 'keep-alive',
        'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream',
      });
      res.write('retry: 1000\n\n');

      clients.add(res);
      res.once('close', () => clients.delete(res));
    });
  },
};

export function sendReloadSignal(): void {
  clients.forEach((client) => {
    client.write('event: reload\ndata: reload\n\n');
  });
}

export function closeReloadConnections(): void {
  clients.forEach((client) => client.end());
  clients.clear();
}

import type { ReactNode } from 'react';

import { Button } from 'shared/ui/Button';

import styles from './AppLayout.module.css';

type TypeSection = 'orders' | 'customers' | 'invoices';

type PropsAppLayout = {
  activeSection: TypeSection;
  children: ReactNode;
  onSectionChange: (section: TypeSection) => void;
};

const sections: Array<{ id: TypeSection; label: string }> = [
  { id: 'orders', label: 'Orders' },
  { id: 'customers', label: 'Customers' },
  { id: 'invoices', label: 'Invoices' },
];

export function AppLayout({ activeSection, children, onSectionChange }: PropsAppLayout) {
  return (
    <div className={styles.shell}>
      <header className={styles.header}>
        <div>
          <p className={styles.eyebrow}>ARFA Generator demo</p>
          <h1>Order Management</h1>
        </div>
        <nav className={styles.nav} aria-label="Main navigation">
          {sections.map((section) => (
            <Button
              key={section.id}
              variant={activeSection === section.id ? 'primary' : 'secondary'}
              onClick={() => onSectionChange(section.id)}
            >
              {section.label}
            </Button>
          ))}
        </nav>
      </header>
      <main className={styles.main}>{children}</main>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import type { TypeCustomer, TypeCustomerStatus } from 'shared/api/customers';
import { Button } from 'shared/ui/Button';
import { DataTable, type TypeColumn } from 'shared/ui/DataTable';
import { EmptyState } from 'shared/ui/EmptyState';

import { loadCustomers } from '../api';
import { CustomerStatusBadge } from './CustomerStatusBadge';
import styles from './CustomersPage.module.css';

const statuses: Array<TypeCustomerStatus | 'all'> = ['all', 'active', 'blocked', 'archived'];

export function CustomersPage() {
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<TypeCustomerStatus | 'all'>('all');
  const [customers, setCustomers] = useState<Array<TypeCustomer>>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    setLoading(true);

    loadCustomers(filter === 'all' ? undefined : filter).then((result) => {
      if (cancelled) return;

      setCustomers(result.customers);
      setLoading(false);
    });

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [filter]);

  const columns = useMemo<Array<TypeColumn<TypeCustomer>>>(
    () => [
      { key: 'name', title: 'Customer', render: (customer) => customer.name },
      { key: 'email', title: 'Email', render: (customer) => customer.email },
      {
        key: 'status',
        title: 'Status',
        render: (customer) => <CustomerStatusBadge status={customer.status} />,
      },
    ],
    []
  );

  return (
    <section className={styles.page}>
      <div className={styles.toolbar}>
        <div>
          <h2>Customers</h2>
          <p>Review customer account state before processing orders.</p>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.filters}>
          {statuses.map((status) => (
            <Button
              key={status}
              variant={filter === status ? 'primary' : 'secondary'}
              onClick={() => setFilter(status)}
            >
              {status}
            </Button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
      {loading ? (
        <div className={styles.loading}>Loading customers...</div>
      ) : customers.length ? (
        <DataTable columns={columns} getRowKey={(customer) => customer.id} rows={customers} />
      ) : (
        <EmptyState title="No customers found" description="Try another status filter." />
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

import type { TypeInvoice, TypeInvoiceStatus } from 'shared/api/invoices';
import { formatDate } from 'shared/lib/dates';
import { Button } from 'shared/ui/Button';
import { DataTable, type TypeColumn } from 'shared/ui/DataTable';
import { EmptyState } from 'shared/ui/EmptyState';
import { MoneyText } from 'shared/ui/MoneyText';

import { loadInvoices } from '../api';
import { InvoiceStatusBadge } from './InvoiceStatusBadge';
import styles from './InvoicesPage.module.css';

const statuses: Array<TypeInvoiceStatus | 'all'> = [
  'all',
  'draft',
  'sent',
  'paid',
  'overdue',
  'void',
];

export function InvoicesPage() {
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<TypeInvoiceStatus | 'all'>('all');
  const [invoices, setInvoices] = useState<Array<TypeInvoice>>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    setLoading(true);

    loadInvoices(filter === 'all' ? undefined : filter).then((result) => {
      if (cancelled) return;

      setInvoices(result.invoices);
      setLoading(false);
    });

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [filter]);

  const columns = useMemo<Array<TypeColumn<TypeInvoice>>>(
    () => [
      { key: 'id', title: 'Invoice', render: (invoice) => invoice.id },
      { key: 'order', title: 'Order', render: (invoice) => invoice.orderId },
      {
        key: 'amount',
        title: 'Amount',
        render: (invoice) => <MoneyText amount={invoice.amount} currency={invoice.currency} />,
      },
      { key: 'due', title: 'Due', render: (invoice) => formatDate(invoice.dueDate) },
      {
        key: 'status',
        title: 'Status',
        render: (invoice) => <InvoiceStatusBadge status={invoice.status} />,
      },
    ],
    []
  );

  return (
    <section className={styles.page}>
      <div className={styles.toolbar}>
        <div>
          <h2>Invoices</h2>
          <p>Watch billing state for orders that need follow-up.</p>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.filters}>
          {statuses.map((status) => (
            <Button
              key={status}
              variant={filter === status ? 'primary' : 'secondary'}
              onClick={() => setFilter(status)}
            >
              {status}
            </Button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
      {loading ? (
        <div className={styles.loading}>Loading invoices...</div>
      ) : invoices.length ? (
        <DataTable columns={columns} getRowKey={(invoice) => invoice.id} rows={invoices} />
      ) : (
        <EmptyState title="No invoices found" description="Try another status filter." />
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

import type { TypeOrderStatus } from 'shared/api/orders';
import { sleep } from 'shared/lib/timing';

import { ordersData } from './loadOrders';

export async function updateOrderStatus(orderId: string, status: TypeOrderStatus) {
  await sleep(220);

  const order = ordersData.find((item) => item.id === orderId);

  if (!order) throw new Error(`Order not found: ${orderId}`);

  order.status = status;

  return { order };
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import type { TypeOrder, TypeOrderStatus } from 'shared/api/orders';
import { formatDate } from 'shared/lib/dates';
import { Button } from 'shared/ui/Button';
import { DataTable, type TypeColumn } from 'shared/ui/DataTable';
import { EmptyState } from 'shared/ui/EmptyState';
import { MoneyText } from 'shared/ui/MoneyText';

import { loadOrders, updateOrderStatus } from '../api';
import { OrderStatusBadge } from './OrderStatusBadge';
import styles from './OrdersPage.module.css';

const statuses: Array<TypeOrderStatus | 'all'> = [
  'all',
  'draft',
  'confirmed',
  'packed',
  'shipped',
  'cancelled',
];

export function OrdersPage() {
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<TypeOrderStatus | 'all'>('all');
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState<Array<TypeOrder>>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [savingOrderId, setSavingOrderId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    setLoading(true);

    loadOrders(filter === 'all' ? undefined : filter).then((result) => {
      if (cancelled) return;

      setOrders(result.orders);
      setLoading(false);
    });

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [filter]);

  const columns = useMemo<Array<TypeColumn<TypeOrder>>>(
    () => [
      { key: 'id', title: 'Order', render: (order) => order.id },
      { key: 'date', title: 'Created', render: (order) => formatDate(order.createdAt) },
      {
        key: 'total',
        title: 'Total',
        render: (order) => <MoneyText amount={order.total} currency={order.currency} />,
      },
      {
        key: 'status',
        title: 'Status',
        render: (order) => <OrderStatusBadge status={order.status} />,
      },
      {
        key: 'action',
        title: 'Action',
        render: (order) => (
          <Button
            disabled={savingOrderId === order.id || order.status === 'shipped'}
            onClick={() => {
              setSavingOrderId(order.id);
              updateOrderStatus(order.id, 'shipped').then(({ order: updatedOrder }) => {
                setOrders((current) =>
                  current.map((item) => (item.id === updatedOrder.id ? updatedOrder : item))
                );
                setSavingOrderId(null);
              });
            }}
          >
            Mark shipped
          </Button>
        ),
      },
    ],
    [savingOrderId]
  );

  return (
    <section className={styles.page}>
      <div className={styles.toolbar}>
        <div>
          <h2>Orders</h2>
          <p>Track fulfillment status and move confirmed orders forward.</p>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.filters}>
          {statuses.map((status) => (
            <Button
              key={status}
              variant={filter === status ? 'primary' : 'secondary'}
              onClick={() => setFilter(status)}
            >
              {status}
            </Button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
      {loading ? (
        <div className={styles.loading}>Loading orders...</div>
      ) : orders.length ? (
        <DataTable columns={columns} getRowKey={(order) => order.id} rows={orders} />
      ) : (
        <EmptyState title="No orders found" description="Try another status filter." />
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

export function createMessages<TMessages extends Record<string, string>>(
  scope: string,
  messages: TMessages
) {
  const result = {} as Record<keyof TMessages, { defaultValue: string; name: string }>;

  for (const key in messages) {
    result[key] = { name: `${scope}/${key}`, defaultValue: messages[key] };
  }

  return result;
}

import type { ReactNode } from 'react';

import styles from './DataTable.module.css';

export type TypeColumn<TRow> = {
  key: string;
  title: string;
  render: (row: TRow) => ReactNode;
};

type PropsDataTable<TRow> = {
  columns: Array<TypeColumn<TRow>>;
  getRowKey: (row: TRow) => string;
  rows: Array<TRow>;
};

export function DataTable<TRow>({ columns, getRowKey, rows }: PropsDataTable<TRow>) {
  return (
    <div className={styles.wrap}>
      <table className={styles.table}>
        <thead>
          <tr>
            {columns.map((column) => (
              <th key={column.key}>{column.title}</th>
            ))}
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {rows.map((row) => (
            <tr key={getRowKey(row)}>
              {columns.map((column) => (
                <td key={column.key}>{column.render(row)}</td>
              ))}
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

ts
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react';
import { defineConfig } from 'vite';

function tsPathsToViteAlias(): Record<string, string> {
  const tsconfig: Record<string, any> = JSON.parse(
    fs.readFileSync(path.resolve('tsconfig.json'), 'utf-8')
  );
  const aliases: Record<string, string> = {};

  Object.entries(tsconfig.compilerOptions?.paths).forEach(([alias, substitutions]) => {
    aliases[alias.replace(/\/\*$/, '')] = path.resolve(
      (substitutions as any)[0].replace(/\/\*$/, '')
    );
  });

  return aliases;
}

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [react()],
  resolve: { alias: tsPathsToViteAlias() },
  server: { port: 5174 },
});
